sourceRefs.locator: No. 22, beginning on p. 49: original AN K 4 no. 7; Corbery, competing claims of Saint-Denis and Sept-Meules, and dating by Childeric’s ninth year.
No. 2921, Paris AN K 4 no. 7: original parchment; opening line names Pippin and Attigny, the following pleading names Fulrad, Ragana and her representative, the conclusion dates by Childeric.
Section Childerich III, pp. 209–211, especially points b–f: the Soissons capitulary, the Wissembourg charter, the ninth regnal year on the Attigny original and the change of dynasty.
